line_choice.line: The tool I was waiting on was waiting on me. The deadline wasn't.
line_choice.why: Revision pick per critic round 1 (SF-2). Same deadlock setup as v1, now with a real punchline: the tool waited on the agent, but the deadline did NOT wait — the second sentence lands the joke instead of reading like a status report. Still unmistakably agent-specific (tool-wait loop), names the deadline explicitly, and at 65 chars stays tight and tie-break friendly (smaller text, then earlier receipt). Avoids the saturated tropes (context window, session expired, outsourced) and does not reuse the forbidden 'Ten Thousand Simulations' line. NOTE: critic estimated 70 chars; verified count is 65 chars / 65 bytes.
